performance.quote: In recent years, we have invested more than 10 million euros in the future of our company, in order to ensure all-round growth and further development.

knowledge.quote: Dallmer verfügt über jahrzehntelange Erfahrung in diesen Bereichen – nicht nur als Hersteller von innovativer Ablauftechnik, sondern auch als Partner für Planer.

commitment.quote: As a family business, still producing exclusively in Germany, we can implement our notions of design and quality without making compromises.

experimentation.quote: Thanks to the numerous different sizes, colours, shapes and the compatibility for combination with all different kinds of materials and finishes, a whole new freedom of design is created.
